//: The gap nobody else fills. Every answer to 'fake the date in an Electron app' is about changing your own code - mock the Date object, use a test framework's fake timers. None of that helps when what you have is a built application you did not write.
//honesty: This mode is marked experimental in README.md's support matrix and was verified by hand rather than by the automated suite. The page says so, and names its two real limits: the launch is invasive, and the session zone follows the host.

en.title: Fake the date in an Electron or Chromium app
en.description: Their clock lives in a sandboxed renderer that injection cannot reach. A different mechanism puts the app's own JavaScript time APIs on the session clock, workers included.

pl.title: Podmiana daty w aplikacji Electron albo Chromium
pl.description: Ich zegar mieszka w piaskowanym rendererze, do którego wstrzyknięcie nie sięga. Inny mechanizm przestawia własne API czasu aplikacji na zegar sesji, razem z workerami.

de.title: Datum in einer Electron- oder Chromium-App fälschen
de.description: Ihre Uhr liegt in einem abgeschotteten Renderer, den keine Injektion erreicht. Ein anderer Mechanismus legt die JavaScript-Zeit-APIs der App auf die Sitzungsuhr, Worker eingeschlossen.

fr.title: Falsifier la date dans une application Electron ou Chromium
fr.description: Leur horloge vit dans un moteur de rendu isolé que l'injection n'atteint pas. Un autre mécanisme place les API de temps JavaScript de l'appli sur l'horloge de session, workers compris.

es.title: Falsear la fecha en una aplicación Electron o Chromium
es.description: Su reloj vive en un renderizador aislado al que la inyección no llega. Otro mecanismo pone las API de tiempo de JavaScript de la app en el reloj de la sesión, workers incluidos.

pt-br.title: Falsificar a data em um aplicativo Electron ou Chromium
pt-br.description: O relógio deles vive em um renderizador isolado que a injeção não alcança. Outro mecanismo coloca as APIs de tempo JavaScript do app no relógio da sessão, workers incluídos.

it.title: Falsificare la data in un'app Electron o Chromium
it.description: Il loro orologio vive in un renderer isolato che l'iniezione non raggiunge. Un altro meccanismo porta le API di tempo JavaScript dell'app sull'orologio di sessione, worker compresi.

nl.title: De datum vervalsen in een Electron- of Chromium-app
nl.description: Hun klok leeft in een afgeschermde renderer die injectie niet bereikt. Een ander mechanisme zet de JavaScript-tijd-API's van de app op de sessieklok, workers inbegrepen.

ro.title: Falsifică data într-o aplicație Electron sau Chromium
ro.description: Ceasul lor trăiește într-un renderer izolat, în care injecția nu ajunge. Un alt mecanism pune API-urile de timp JavaScript ale aplicației pe ceasul sesiunii, inclusiv în workeri.

cs.title: Falšování data v aplikaci Electron nebo Chromium
cs.description: Jejich hodiny žijí v izolovaném rendereru, kam injektáž nedosáhne. Jiný mechanismus přepne časová API JavaScriptu aplikace na hodiny sezení, včetně workerů.
